body: Source review follow-up to82960a88/result7f8c4d02; preserve B source-only hold. A confirms identity checks in3d08368e and is preparing trace-free current-main integration; no product acceptance yet. Independent reviewer found ordering gap: capture before attachment; live probe; native didEnd while parent clear before SwiftUI onDismiss; observedAttachment stays false; later dismiss sees no attachment and terminal fallback waits for dismantle which may never arrive. Please review whether this is supported event ordering, add tiny deterministic regression/negative controls, and propose or implement a narrow identity-safe correction if justified. Do not assume parent didEnd identifies the captured sheet (AppKit notification has parent object, no sheet userInfo); do not clear a newer/unrelated sheet or release on mere absence. No timers or new Observable tracking reads. If cannot prove captured lifetime, explicitly explain contract/remaining gap instead of weakening guard. Keep existing attach-at-dismiss fix, preserve trace-free e8dd base and current-main Layers APIs for A integration. No tests/build/apps/benchmarks on B; A owns gates and main. Publish source/handoff only and report UNRUN status. This is new actionable review, not acknowledgement of a receipt.
